subject.title: message_tool_only: one-shot delivery reminder loses to recency over long tool chains, turns end in withheld finals

question: For long `message_tool_only` turns that end with a substantive plain final, should OpenClaw add periodic in-turn delivery reminders, bounded withheld-final recovery, or both?
rationale: The code proves the current one-time hint and warning-only suppression path, but the fix choice changes prompt context, duplicate-delivery risk, and the documented privacy contract for opted-in lanes.

options.title: Combine Reminder And Recovery
options.body: Add a fixed-size reminder after bounded tool activity and coordinate it with a one-shot sanitized recovery path for substantive private finals.

options.title: Recovery Only
options.body: Rely on the existing stranded-final recovery direction to repair misses after they happen without adding prompt traffic during long tool chains.

options.title: Reminder Only
options.body: Refresh the delivery instruction during long turns while leaving withheld-final retry or diagnostics to separate recovery work.

recommendation.title: Combine Reminder And Recovery
recommendation.body: Add a fixed-size reminder after bounded tool activity and coordinate it with a one-shot sanitized recovery path for substantive private finals.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses source-channel privacy, prompt-context behavior, and the active recovery PR, and this handle appears in the merge/rewrite history for the current warning path.
